title: Exact exponential shell-tail majorant for rectangular edge weights
question: For edge weights w(x)=2^(-||x||_1) on a finite rectangular subset of Z^3, is the total weight outside l1 radius R bounded exactly by 3*(4R^2+8R+14)*2^(1-R) for every R>=1?

finite_contract.box_family: all ordered side triples in [box_side_min, box_side_max]^3

assumptions: The ambient comparison lattice is Z^3 with l1 shell counts N_3(0)=1 and N_3(n)=4*n^2+2 for n>=1.
Finite rectangular boxes use only positive coordinate nearest-neighbour edges and therefore form a subset of the ambient lattice edge set after translation.
Each edge has nonnegative weight determined only by its lower endpoint l1 radius.
The executable [2,8]^3 sweep is a finite audit of the analytic shell formula and is not a volume limit.
The geometric bound is only a scalar weight majorant; it is not a commutator, operator-domain or state estimate.
missing_assumptions: A Q3LOCK-specific identification of the actual interaction or commutator with this scalar edge weight.
Representation-independent common-core and weighted product-domain estimates.
Source-, cutoff-, phase-, volume-, shape- and history-uniform operator norms or state-weighted commutator bounds.
All-shape exhaustion Cauchy, Lie--Trotter/common-alpha convergence, OS/KMS/GNS and sector coercivity.
Physical-empty, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap conclusions.
stop_conditions: If a shell count or tail recurrence disagrees, fail the geometric audit.
If any finite box tail exceeds the ambient formula, fail the dominance check.
If a hostile mutation promotes the scalar bound to commutator, operator or physical scope, reject it.
Do not identify the scalar tail with the Q3 history tail without a separately proved transfer theorem.
evidence_level: T0 / EXACT SCALAR SHELL-COUNT AND GEOMETRIC TAIL MAJORANT WITH FINITE RECTANGULAR CROSS-CHECK
non_claims: No Q3LOCK commutator or history-tail estimate.
No weighted operator, common-core, common-alpha or exhaustion theorem.
No OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.
No Yang-Mills dynamics or mass-gap conclusion.

lean_crosscheck.role: Lean checks exact shell-count and closed-form arithmetic fixtures; Python proves the finite dominance and recurrence rows.

boundary: R-444 closes only the scalar exponential shell-tail formula and finite rectangular dominance for the declared edge weight. It does not close a Q3LOCK commutator or history tail, weighted operator domains, common core, common alpha, exhaustion, physical-empty, Sector-A, Pre-A, Yang-Mills or mass-gap claims.
